scenario.name: superuser-admin-console
scenario.description: Permanent sample proving the super-user admin console (identity + workspace built-in packs, Store, Box View) alongside ordinary business CRUD, browser-verified end to end.

notes: internal.tables=true (config.json defaults) composes the built-in identity (User/Role/UserRole) and workspace (Menu/Preference) packs into this app as real internal tables, in addition to the app-modeled Project/Note business concepts.

The 'api-dev' key (config.json trialDefaults.apiKey) resolves to the dev/ADMIN principal when auth.mode is left at its default (apiKey) with no real auth wired -- it is also the manifest's auth.devKeyHint, so the business UI auto-fills it and authenticates as super-user on load.
Use 'dev,trial' (not 'dev,step0,trial') to boot against the real H2Local database in Input/db.definition.json -- step0 would override it with an ephemeral in-memory store.

Super-user-only surfaces once booted: an 'Admin' nav group (identity/workspace concepts), 'Store' (GET /api/admin/packs), and 'Box View' (GET /api/admin/box, the only place truth level is bumped to T3_RUNS_LOCALLY).

Note is overridden to ui.frame.mode=minimal: opening it hides the header/sidenav chrome, leaving only its own content plus a '← Back to app' escape-hatch link (the only way back short of a full page reload, since the SPA has no hash-router).
